stem: What is one difference between the two essays?

options.label: A
options.text: “Voyageurs” describes the behavior of many observers, while the excerpt from One Kingdom: Our Lives with Animals reveals only the author’s actions.

options.label: B
options.text: “Voyageurs” explains the findings of scientific studies, while the excerpt from One Kingdom: Our Lives with Animals includes only the author’s viewpoint.

options.label: C
options.text: “Voyageurs” describes wild animals in their natural habitat, while the excerpt from One Kingdom: Our Lives with Animals describes animals in captivity.

options.label: D
options.text: “Voyageurs” advocates for wildlife preservation, while the excerpt from One Kingdom: Our Lives with Animals argues that animals are safer in captivity.
